name: Leonard Victor
source:
Leonard Victor has long served as the Chancellor of the Empire of Noxheim. Cunning and shrewd, he deftly sidesteps Irena's opinions and often maneuvers matters to suit the interest of the aristocracy.

[Translated from the [url=https://www.escude.co.jp/product/imperium/chara08.html]official website[/url]]
